content: Hi! How can I help you with the meeting files today?
Hey, thanks! I tried opening the meeting recording you sent, but I got a permissions error. Can you check?
Absolutely, thanks for catching that. I just updated the sharing settings, can you try clicking the new link in the 'Team Meeting - June' folder? Let me know if it works!
That did the trick for the video, but I can't see the slide deck. Is it in a different spot?

Good eye! The deck might not have finished uploading earlier. I'm re-uploading now, once it's ready, you'll see 'Presentation Slides.pdf' right next to the video. Feel free to browse the folder in about five minutes.
Okay, I'll check back. By the way, can I download the original files? I want to add notes.
Of course! Once the upload completes, just click the download arrow next to each file or use 'Download All' for the zipped folder. Originals are yours to keep and annotate.
Great, thanks for organizing this! Should I let you know if I spot anything missing?
Yes, please! If anything's missing or doesn't open, just reply here. I'm happy to resend or adjust permissions as needed.
I see the slides now. Everything opened smoothly this time.
Fantastic! Thanks for your patience. If you want to tidy things up, you can create subfolders or rename items, this helps everyone find what they need. Let me know if you'd like help organizing.
I'll try sorting them later. Thanks for all your help!
You're welcome! Always happy to make collaboration easier. If you need more exports or have ideas for future meetings, just drop a message. Enjoy working with the files!
